_comment: Monolith-growth census baseline (DS-016). The shared rhiz-lint monolith-growth check (rhiz_growth engine, from rhizome tools-stable) reads this and bands docket's hand-grown source against the thresholds. `rhiz census` drills the bands. Adopted 2026-07-18 as a forward tripwire: docket's source is under threshold today, so this arms the alert for future growth rather than flagging an existing monolith. Generated output (docket.html) and vendored rhizome tools (tools/) are out of scan scope.
